findings.highlight: ask her about another magus, about Shinji
findings.evidenceJa: 魔術師の家系繋がりで、慎二の事を訊いて
findings.governingReading: using the connection between mage lineages, ask her about Shinji
findings.explanation: The English calls Shinji another magus precisely before the scene establishes that he is not one.

findings.highlight: all the magi with a history that live here
findings.evidenceJa: 歴史のある魔術師の家系
findings.governingReading: all the historic mage lineages in the region
findings.explanation: Her territorial knowledge of families becomes knowledge of individual magi with personal histories.

findings.highlight: I guess my thinking he couldn’t be a Master backfired
findings.governingReading: I only learned this morning myself
findings.explanation: The timing and Rin’s own recent discovery disappear.

findings.highlight: my thinking he couldn’t be a Master
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二がマスターになる訳ないってタカをくくってた
findings.governingReading: I complacently assumed there was no way Shinji could become a Master
findings.explanation: Rin’s explicit overconfidence and its strength are weakened.

findings.highlight: I told him not to do anything
findings.evidenceJa: 慎二には大人しくしておけって言った
findings.governingReading: I told Shinji to keep quiet and stay out of trouble
findings.explanation: Rin’s warning to remain docile becomes a blanket prohibition on any action.

findings.evidenceJa: ここで納得する訳にもいかない
findings.governingReading: I cannot simply accept that and leave the matter there
findings.explanation: Shirou’s refusal to end his inquiry becomes an unrelated inability to stop Rin.
Shirou’s hypothesis about the Servant’s technical skill collapses magecraft into magic.
The boundary field’s activation becomes the revelation of a preexisting “disorder.”

findings.evidenceJa: 意識を麻痺させようとする
findings.explanation: A dangerous attempted effect on consciousness becomes a completed bodily state.
The boundary field’s sustained incapacitation is weakened to fainting.
The oppressive air induces a figurative misperception, not a clinical hallucination.
Shirou’s visceral revulsion becomes interpersonal hatred.

findings.highlight: the classroom, the one nearest to the stairs
findings.evidenceJa: 四階、階段に一番近い教室
findings.governingReading: the fourth-floor classroom nearest the stairs
findings.explanation: The floor locating Shirou and Rin’s response disappears.

findings.highlight: It doesn’t mean we won’t make it.
findings.evidenceJa: まだ間に合わない訳じゃない
findings.governingReading: It may not be too late yet
findings.explanation: The urgent possibility of saving the students is obscured by an unnatural double negative.

findings.highlight: convulsing, foaming at the mouth like it’s a bad joke.
findings.evidenceJa: 全身を弛緩させて、濁った眼球を覗かせていた
findings.explanation: A conditional English variant invents convulsions, foaming, and a flippant simile contrary to the active Japanese state.
A conditional English variant reverses the victims’ bodily transformation.

findings.highlight: The human skin is slowly melting like mud sliding off of plaster.
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たい炎にあぶられ、生気をかすめとられた皮膚
findings.governingReading: skin seared by cold flame and robbed of vitality
findings.explanation: The same variant invents liquefying skin and an unsupported plaster simile.

findings.highlight: The way the melting skin drips onto the floor makes me picture a giant stomach.
findings.evidenceJa: 蝋細工のように不気味な光を反射している
findings.explanation: mirror moon adds dripping flesh and a giant-stomach image absent from the original Japanese.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は息を殺している
findings.explanation: Rin’s controlled physical reaction to the classroom is replaced with stated astonishment.
